to.name: IPv6 Next Header use of the protocol-number namespace
to.revision: IPv6 use within same IANA registry

property: The numeric namespace used to identify IPv4 payload protocols is carried into IPv6 Next Header semantics even though the IPv6 base/header architecture is not a wire-compatible revision of IPv4.

sources.locator: IANA Protocol Numbers registry introduction and table
sources.supports: same registry values used for IPv4 Protocol and IPv6 Next Header

negative_claims: This edge does not claim IPv6 inherited the IPv4 header format.
It does not claim every Protocol value is valid or used identically in every IPv6 header chain.
open_questions: Trace exact transition documents and extension-header handling rules by protocol number.
notes: A numeric interoperability namespace survives a major network-layer redesign.
